name: Jealous Abjurer
disable: DC 36 Arcana check, DC 36 Nature check, DC 36 Occultism check, or DC 36 Religion check (master) to convince the spirit that the target's magical knowledge is too great to be trifled with

items.name: Rend Magic
items.text:
Trigger A creature that is currently affected by a beneficial spell approaches within 30 feet of the abjurer.

---

Effect Envying the fame and magical prowess of others, the jealous abjurer attempts to engineer a catastrophic failure in the highest-level beneficial spell currently affecting its target. It attempts a counteract check with a +26 modifier. If the counteract check succeeds, the spell is dispelled, and the creature it had been affecting takes 4d12+30 force damage as the spell violently implodes (DC 32 basic Reflex save save).

text: A robe-clad spirit rises out of the floor, pointing an accusing finger.
